antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 810nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in melanocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Single-wavelength 810nm: CcO activation at 370 THz, 10^-15s, continuous wave 40min targeting cytochrome_c_oxidase in melanocyte. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows ATP +28% at 810nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_II_SDH activation.
